You do the small version every day and, like, it builds on its own. Um, the mistake people make is waiting to feel ready. You know, ready is a feeling that shows up after you start. I used to think discipline was the whole answer, and I would plan a week nobody could really do, then miss a day and quit the plan instead of the day. What changed was making the habit small enough that missing it felt stupid. Five minutes. Not an hour, just five minutes I can do standing in a kitchen. And the five minutes usually turns into more, but only because it was allowed to be five. 3 landed pauses Silence you chose, before a new point. Q&A, level 1 1 of 2 counted.
